title: Decision inspector
lede: Any decision of any age: its rule and version, what each fact read, the replay, and the message checked by its hash.
failed: The decision could not be read.

access.deniedHint: Reading a decision needs the decision-log read grant. Ask HQ to grant it.

fact.title: What each fact read
fact.unknown: Unknown: the message did not say
fact.unparsed: Unparsed: the value could not be read as its type

message.title: The message
message.failed: The message could not be read. The typed values above still stand.
message.held: A kept copy is still held.
message.purged: The kept copy has been purged. The typed values above still explain this decision.

kept.match: From the kept copy. It matches the hash.
kept.differs: From the kept copy. It differs from the hash, so it is not the message this decision read.

refetched.match: Re-fetched from the Nphies service, shown and not kept. It matches the hash.
refetched.differs: Re-fetched from the Nphies service, shown and not kept. It differs from the hash, so it is not the message this decision read.

check.notFound: Not found in the kept copies or the Nphies service. The typed values above still stand.
